caveat: n=1 reader (this model) working carefully; this shows the contract is sufficient, not that any reader will be error-free. Carried state means one arithmetic slip changes that row's digits and every later row's — the known fragility of recurrence elision, disclosed in the codec header and docs; shipped exception rows (when present) re-anchor the chain.
